comfort.heading: Relax. We have taken care of it.
comfort.quote: “Tell us the time, and that is the time.”
comfort.intro: Say 8:00 in the morning and your driver is at your hotel at 8:00. Say 9:00 and it is 9:00. Nothing in this plan is fixed against your wishes — this page tells you exactly how your two days will feel, so there is nothing to wonder about.
tiles: Pickup is at the time you tell us, whether that is 8 or 9 AM. We confirm it with you the evening before, and your driver is there on the minute.
There are no fixed meal stops. Tell your guide or driver what you like, and they suggest clean, comfortable places close to where you are, with mild-spice options. Meals are at your own cost.
Want longer at a monument, a rest, or to change the order? Just say so. The plan bends to you, within the opening hours of each place.
The same professional driver stays with you the whole time, and a licensed English-speaking guide joins you at the monuments. The driver takes you to your hotel at the end of each day.
There are no compulsory shopping stops. Every price is on page 4, and monument tickets are charged at the exact official price with nothing added.
A message away, day and night
Your WhatsApp line to our team stays open during your trip. Any change or question, just write.

days.title: Delhi to Agra · Baby Taj and sunset
rows: Your driver meets you at the hotel at the time you choose — 8:00 or 9:00, exactly as you say. Then the private transfer to Agra, about 3.5–4 hours depending on traffic, with a comfort break on the way.
Your licensed English-speaking guide takes you through this delicate marble tomb on the river, famous for its inlay work and often called the “Baby Taj”.
The garden across the Yamuna, with the best view of the Taj Mahal as the evening light changes.
Your driver takes you to your hotel. Dinner and rest are at your own pace.

days.title: Taj Mahal at sunrise · Agra Fort · back to Delhi
rows: Early start, with a pickup time agreed with you the evening before. Your guide shows you the Taj Mahal in the first light, including the main mausoleum, with its story, its inlay work and time for photographs.
Back to the hotel for a relaxed breakfast and your check-out, at your pace.
Your guide takes you through the red sandstone fort, the great Mughal palace by the river.
The drive back, about 3.5–4 hours depending on traffic, to the address you give us. End of services.

good_to_know: Good to know. The Taj Mahal is closed every Friday; your visit is on Tuesday 1 December, so you are clear. Monument opening and closing times are set by the authorities, so we plan each visit inside them. Driving times depend on traffic.
included: Private AC sedan with driver for both days, with fuel, tolls, parking and taxes
Itimad-ud-Daulah, Mehtab Bagh, the Taj Mahal including the main mausoleum, and Agra Fort, at the official price.
